lead: Final test of 0.8.41 before today's release: the CI test build 43617677008 of the round head (8df3a01), with everything since rc8 (Mac MIDI input "Virus TI MIDI", 8 reads pending per MIDI endpoint, unlink at the DAW's close, option live-later, new sync log lines). risk.py: class C on all three systems, so the automated core runs (Linux hil.sh: cold, reopen, export, sleep; Mac hil-mac and the VM hil-win: cold, reopen, export), by hand Virus off/on everywhere and sleep on the Mac. The round's own items cover what no rc test showed yet. The libusb audio path (#37) is not in this release. Mark each item and add a note where something looks different; Claude reads the marks from this page.
rules: Order: Linux first (the Virus is there), then the Mac, then the Windows VM. Close the DAW before the Virus moves.
Never power-cycle the Virus while it is attached to the VM.
Use a disposable project. Nothing in this round stores to the Virus.
No game or other heavy program running during the timing items.

sections.title: Linux
sections.where: This PC, REAPER, the 0.8.41 CI build (installed by Claude)
prep: Nothing to install. The Virus is on Linux. Claude runs hil.sh first and posts the result here.

items.title: Automated core run (Claude runs it)
steps: Claude runs scripts/hil.sh with the installed CI build.
items.expect: ALL PASS (cold start, two reopens after the idle exit, export, broker killed while playing). The broker journal has link off after each session and no vti: read ep errors.

items.title: Options page
steps: Open the Control Center, page Options.
Check the list, switch Even rhythm for played notes on, open the plug-in in REAPER, then switch it off again.
items.expect: All options listed with their texts (lower latency, slip restart, live notes, even rhythm, plug-in log ...); the plug-in log shows the option on for that session (Claude checks).

items.title: Arpeggiator after a 1-bar count-in (#30)
steps: REAPER, a patch with the arpeggiator on, a MIDI item holding a chord from bar 2.
Record or play with a 1-bar count-in (Options, Metronome, count-in before playback), three times; then once from the middle of a bar.
items.expect: The arpeggio starts on the beat with the click each time, also after the count-in; no stumble at the restart.

items.title: Close and reopen REAPER
steps: Close REAPER with the plug-in loaded, wait 10 s, open the project again and play.
items.expect: It plays as before after the reopen (unlink at the close and link again before the next session). No hanging notes.

sections.title: Windows 11 VM
sections.where: win11 VM, Ableton Live, the 0.8.41 CI build (installed by Claude, setup.exe /quiet)
prep: Claude passes the Virus through to the VM and runs hil-win for the automated core items.

items.title: Automated core run (Claude runs it)
steps: Claude runs hil-win in the VM.
items.expect: Pass on cold start, reopen and export (drift up to about 120 ppm is the VM, accepted before).

items.title: Plays in Live; Options page and lower latency
steps: Open the plug-in in Live, play a clip 30 s.
In the Control Center, Options: switch lower latency on, reload the plug-in, play again; then off.
items.expect: Plays cleanly both times; with lower latency on, Live shows a smaller plug-in delay. VM USB timing is not exact, so crackle here proves little, missing notes do.

sections.title: macOS
sections.where: MacBook Air M3, Ableton Live 12 and Logic Pro, the 0.8.41 CI build (you install the package; Claude pushes it)
prep: Quit the DAW, then double-click Install test build.command in ~/Downloads/TI-Revive-0.8.41-mac, or paste: sudo installer -pkg "$HOME/Downloads/TI-Revive-0.8.41-mac/TI Revive.pkg" -target /
Move the Virus' USB cable to the Mac and switch it on if needed. Claude checks the installed version with pkgutil before trusting a result.
Run hil-mac.command from the package for the automated core items (cold start, reopen, export).

items.title: MIDI ports "Virus TI Synth" and "Virus TI MIDI"
steps: With the plug-in loaded in Live: Settings, Link/Tempo/MIDI. Then Logic, MIDI settings or a track's input menu.
items.expect: Both inputs are listed, "Virus TI Synth" and the new "Virus TI MIDI" (the DIN MIDI In). Nothing on DIN to test with, so only that they show up.

items.title: Even rhythm for played notes (live-later)
steps: Control Center, Options: switch Even rhythm for played notes on.
Live, plug-in track armed, monitor In: run keystamp from ~/tirevive-test/keystamp as in the E518 test (run A), then switch the option off again.
items.expect: Played notes sound evenly spaced; Claude reads the plug-in's klog lines: spacing 24000 +-1 frames for every note (with the option off it was up to +-128).

items.title: Logic: arpeggiator after a 1-bar count-in (#30)
steps: Logic, the Audio Unit on a track, an arp patch, a region with a chord from bar 2.
Record with a 1-bar count-in three times.
items.expect: The arpeggio starts on the beat with the click every time (the #30 reporter confirmed it on a Snow with rc5; this is our own check).
